modules.module_title: • prepare required raw materials to make wooden toy

pcs.pc_description: list raw materials required for making the wooden toy
differentiate between various types of woods like mango wood, eucalyptus wood, etc. that are required to create wooden toy
collect raw materials like color lac, sand paper, banana fiber/screwpine leaf (talegari) in prescribed quantities
arrange raw materials carefully for further usage in making appropriate wooden toy
deliver remaining raw material to the designated storage locations
collect tools like chisel, curved chisel, mini band saw, hammer to cut wooden logs
collect tools to carve the log, smoothen surface of the wood
arrange tools like curve chisel, sharp edge chisel at designated location

modules.module_title: follow safety measures while handling wood

pcs.pc_description: use PPE for specific tasks and work conditions
handle chisel, hammer, etc. carefully
use safety goggles, boots, gloves, face mask while handling wood
carry out jobs which cause sparking in a safe manner, creating sufficient distance between flammable items and the sparking

modules.module_title: perform toy making operation as per the standard procedures

pcs.pc_description: cut wooden blocks into required size as per the final product requirement in a safe manner
cut rough knots of the wooden block using hammer, chisel, etc. safely
demonstrate the process of cutting wooden blocks into smaller/similar pieces using mini band saw/chisel/blade machine
fix piece of wooden log into wood turner
perform carving of log using curved chisel/chisel on wood turner
demonstrate how to smoothen the surface of log using chisel
provide depth and design to the log to give shape of toy using chisel
smoothen the surface of prepared toy using sand paper
apply color lac for decoration purpose
perform polishing with screwpine leaf (talegari)/ banana fiber to give gross finish

modules.module_title: check toy quality and productivity standards

pcs.pc_description: demonstrate the inspection process based on the quality standard parameters to ensure appropriate sanding is being achieved
demonstrate the steps to be followed while maintaining records of inspection results/tests
ensure that there is no wastage of materials
prepare a sample template to collect information during inspection based on toy’s surface, color and polishing quality
identify different types of parameters required to ensure appropriate amount of inventory is being stored at the time of production
